MLB Network AnalystAlbert Pujols, a 22-year Major League veteran and 11-time MLB All-Star, is an analyst appearing across MLB Network’s programming, including the Emmy Award-winning flagship studio show MLB Tonight. Pujols is also a Special Assistant to the Commissioner, consulting with MLB on a range of topics, including player relations and issues regarding the Dominican Republic, his home country.
